blocks.text: Mission townhomes that sold: price bands and sub-areas, November 2025 to October 2026

The 65 townhomes that closed in Mission over the 12 months had a $679,900 median, and the middle half sold between $635,000 and $709,900. That is a long way inside a $1,200,000 ceiling: 64 of the 65 sold below $800,000, fewer than five sold between $800,000 and $999,999, and none sold at $1,000,000 or more. A search for Mission townhomes under $1.2 million therefore covers the whole townhome market, not a part of it.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. A price band is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

blocks.text: Most of the activity is in the Mission BC sub-area (55 of the 65 sales, $679,000 median, 30 days to sell), followed by Mission-West (9 sales, $685,000 median, 14 days). The only complexes with five or more sales were Skyview (10 sales, $714,900 median), Spencer Estates (5 sales, $415,000 median) in Mission BC and Archer Green (7 sales, $680,000 median) in Mission-West. The median year built is 2021, and the median strata fee is $349 a month ($4,188 a year, 0.62% of the median price).

By quarter the median was $687,500 in November to January (16 sales); $692,500 in February to April (22 sales); $675,000 in May to July (17 sales); $641,704 in August to October (10 sales). The most recent quarter has 10 sales, so it is a smaller sample than the others and should be read with that in mind. Homes took 25 days to sell at 98.6% of the last list price, and 3% sold above list.

Do all Mission townhomes sell for less than $1.2 million?
faq.a: In the last 12 months, yes. All 65 townhomes that closed in Mission sold under $1,000,000, and the median was $679,900. Townhomes at or above $1.2 million did not appear in the sales data.

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a Mission townhome?
faq.a: The median across 64 sales was $349 a month, $4,188 a year. Fees were lower in the Mission BC sub-area ($310 median) than in Mission-West ($401).
